newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Sanwa HK unit closes mortgage-backed issue.
newsitem.headline: Sanwa HK unit closes mortgage-backed issue.

text.p: Hong Kong Homes Funding Corp (1) Ltd's US$144 million residential mortgage-backed securities issue has been completed, lead manager Sanwa International Finance said on Friday.
The issuer is a special purpose vehicle incorporated in the Cayman Islands, and the notes securitise a portion of the mortgage portfolio of Sanwa Finance Hong Kong.

The notes, which mature in May 2017, were priced and re-offered at par. They paid a coupon of 20 basis points over the three-month U.S. dollar London Interbank Offered Rate up to August 2007 and 45 basis points over the three-month dollar LIBOR thereafter.
Fees are 12.5 basis points, split as 7.5 basis points for management and underwriting and five basis points for selling.
The notes are 100 percent guaranteed by MBIA Insurance Corp and are expected to be rated AAA by Standard and Poor's Corp and Aaa by Moody's Investors Service.
The issue is the first cross-border AAA/Aaa-rated mortage-backed securities issue collateralized by residential mortgages originated in Hong Kong, Sanwa said.
Sanwa Bank Hong Kong branch is the arranger.
Sanwa International Finance is the lead manager.
Deutsche Morgan Grenfell joined the deal as a manager.
